title: Rumi
blurb: AI interior shopping agent. Led the design agent, chat and planning system. Won Ramp 2nd Place and Long Lake Winner at HackMIT 2026.
description: Scan your room with an iPhone and Rumi rebuilds it in 3D, then an agent shops for furniture that actually fits, checking the measurements and your budget before it places anything.

title: Treehouse
blurb: Go CLI that gives each AI coding agent its own git worktree, so parallel agents don't collide.
description: A worktree manager to run infinite agents!
hook: Worktrees born ready, not born broken.

title: Tailored
description: Internship application season is approaching. Bypass ATS with a custom resume and cover letter :)
hook: bzzzz...  AI Agents??! bzz... bzz... LLMS.. Tokens?!?!?

title: SaaScript
description: Built SaaScript, a "startup buzzword" interpreted programming language featuring a custom bytecode virtual machine in C Implementing a full lexer, parser, and bytecode compiler to translate high-level code into executable bytecode.

title: League of Studies
blurb: Competitive gamified studying for you and your friends.
description: My mom told me to stop playing League of Legends 💔, so I made League of Studies, a gamified study platform instead. Fight with your friends or a boss to study for exams and climb the leaderboard!

title: Tumor Classifier
blurb: A neural net written from scratch.
description: Designed and implemented a neural network from scratch using only NumPy to classify breast growths as benign or malignant. Learning the calculus and linear algebra behind supervised learning models was a great experience.
